about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: Learn more about Dream Yetu
about.description: is the first in Angola to implement Certified Homeschooling, an innovative and internationally recognized teaching model that allows children to learn in the comfort and safety of their own homes, with the same rigor and quality as a conventional school.
about.missionText: To promote quality, inclusive and innovative education, respecting the pace and needs of each child.
about.visionText: To be a reference in innovative education and child development in Angola and Southern Africa.
about.valuesText: Love, respect, innovation, inclusion and educational excellence.
about.historyParagraph1: A Dream Yetu was born from the dream of transforming education in Angola by creating a space where every child can learn at their own pace, with love, respect, and dedication.
about.historyParagraph2: From the beginning, we have been committed to offering innovative educational programs that respect each student's individuality, promoting not only academic development but also emotional and social growth.
about.historyParagraph3: We believe that education begins with love, curiosity, and respect for each child's pace.
